news.title: Butler University Partners with Urban Land Institute to Explore Stronger Connections Across Midtown Indianapolis
news.summary_en: Two-day planning initiative will bring together urban development experts, neighborhood residents, and community leaders to identify opportunities for safer streets, improved connectivity, and shared community spaces Butler University is partnering with the Urban Land Institute (ULI) Indiana District Council to explore new opportunities to connect Butler’s campus with surrounding Midtown Indianapo
news.author: Mark Apple
